reviews.comment: This guy is nice. Some people did not like him because he is difficult, but he makes you really learn the material and show how it can be interesting. The material is also really relevant, like this shouldn't be a blow-off class. He is also good with answering questions in office hours, but his tests were like a train running you over.

Dr. Alge was a great professor who provided students with all the resources needed to succeed. The information taught in class was not only great but taught in a way that really required you to learn the information. Test's apply that information learned through the form of real world problems, that we practiced in lectures very frequently.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Truthfully, I struggled quite a bit with the structure of this course over the semester, but Dr. Alge comes off as a very genuine guy who cares for people and is passionate about what he does. Grading is tough and this is certainly not an easy course to make an A in, but I learned a lot in a class whose content is very important to our degree.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Alge is a fairly good professor when it comes to teaching the material. His slides are thorough and all one really needs to study when it comes to exams. However, the grading for the assignments, quizzes, and tests are extremely specific to the point of loosing points if you don't have the exact wording desired. A bit arbitrary but overall ok.
Professor will not reply to emails and made the class a lot harder than it had to be

Dr. Alge is an incredible prof. The course is very tightly organized, the homework rubrics are a little punishing because of how prescriptive they are, but the discussion questions in class are very reflective of the exams. Overall a great teacher, highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lectures are super boring, you have to go because he takes attendance with socrative. Test 1 was a nightmare but the second one was better. Made is final optional Spring 2020. 3 quizzes, 3 homework, attendance, 2 exams, and a final. His powerpoints are super detailed but have all the information you need to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy
